messages.subject: lavaan 0.6-18 has been released
parts:
Dear all,

A new update of lavaan (0.6.18) is now available on CRAN. (It make take
a day or so before all the binaries are available).

For an overview of all changes, see

https://lavaan.ugent.be/history/dot6.html

A major change in this release is the new syntax parser (written by Luc
De Wilde). If you experience any problems, you can always switch to the
old parser (using the argument parser = "old"). But please let us know,
and send us a reprex!

Another big change is the formatting of the error/warning/note messages.
The formatting is now much more consistent.

Yves.
